The exact upstream LinkedIn supplies the Azerbaijan and SOCAR identity; ICIJ supplies the Azerbaijani Itatzel beneficiary and same-entity shareholder records beginning on 4 January 2007; a captain reports Itatzel as his employer; and the authoritative vessel relationship also begins in 2007. This multi-anchor bridge exceeds the identity threshold but remains short of a direct named-vessel filing.

Searches covered Eldar Mirzayev and Eldar Mirzoev variants. A same-name Euroclima engineer in Baku, a construction professional associated with a Russian contractor and younger student or translation profiles were excluded because their employers, career stages and identifiers do not match the existing LinkedIn. No facts or socials were transferred from them.

ICIJ cautions that people with the same name may be different individuals. Its Baku beneficiary record is the stronger country match; the Mr. Eldar Mirzayev shareholder record carries a Moscow contact address but shares the same entity and start date. The dossier uses these records for identity, gender and chronology support only and does not infer illegality, current ownership, entity purpose or asset value.

The authoritative Serenity II relationship begins in 2007, while public yacht sources date the 40.05-metre vessel's delivery to 2010. The earlier date plausibly reflects a build or ordering relationship and exactly matches Itatzel Marketing's incorporation date, but no correction or stronger legal interpretation is proposed.

A separate 60-metre Serenity II was launched by Alia Yachts in 2026. This dossier uses only the authoritative 40.04-metre, 394-GT Mengi Yay vessel delivered in 2010 and excludes all owner, design and chronology facts from the later namesake.
